name: fast-as-fuck-desktop-command
description: Local Desktop Commander fork with event-driven process output and direct stdio transport.

interface.shortDescription: Fast local files, commands, search, and persistent processes.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Mac to Codex with a native Swift app, fast file and image tools, persistent command sessions, and optional macOS computer controls. The app owns the connection and shows its health. Web access uses account sign-in and explicit device pairing.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use FAST Desktop Command to check the Mac connection and list available sessions.
